programme.title: Dance Moms Miami
programme.sub-title: Pushed to the Edge of the Dancefloor
programme.desc: (M) Stars Dance Studio's best dancers Sammy and Jessi are paired with Hannah in a trio, but when rehearsals run long, dance mom Abby pulls Sammy from practice early.

programme.title: Abby'S Ultimate Dance Competition
programme.desc: Young dancers train and compete under a demanding coach while striving for success in elite competitions.
